name: Northern Kentucky University
oos_note: Non-resident undergraduate tuition & fees 2026-2027 from official NKU Student Account Services tuition schedule (https://www.nku.edu/student-account-services/tuition/): $638/credit hour, $7,848/semester full-time, $15,696/year. This is the standard non-resident rate for students admitted Fall 2025 or later. (A higher legacy non-resident rate of $23,208/yr applies only to non-residents admitted before Fall 2025.) Public university, so out-of-state exceeds the resident KY/OH/IN rate.
